purpose: One bounded public-demo diagnostic of already consumed development controls. Not validation, calibration, population accuracy estimation, or authorization to integrate the vendor into the product.

scope.independenceQualification: Five files do not represent five independent source families. The first three share the same generated parent and/or Sintel source. The last two come from a previously consumed connected negative-study ancestry family. No fresh holdout evidence is created.

stopConditions: Authentication, account creation, credentials, or contact sharing required.
Free-use limit, quota exhaustion, payment requirement, or explicit service refusal.
executionPolicy.onStop: Stop submissions immediately and record every remaining case as not_attempted_due_to_stop. Keep prior outcomes and the visible stopping evidence. Do not bypass, create an account, purchase access, or retry with another session.
executionPolicy.singleCaseFailure: Retain an error/no-result with visible evidence. Continue the next fixed case only if the failure is file-specific and no stopping condition applies.
executionPolicy.noFavorableRetry: Do not resubmit a file after an error, timeout, uncertain result, unfavorable result, or ambiguous submission. Reload/poll only an already accepted in-progress operation if the UI requires it; never start another job.
executionPolicy.capture: Preserve visible submission status, file identity, final video-level verdict and score, temporal graph, timestamps, and screenshots for every attempted case. Retain raw responses only if exposed by the browser UI. Preserve errors, uncertainty, and disagreement; do not replace or omit any result.
executionPolicy.placeholderRule: The initial hidden-result/default98% placeholder is not an outcome. Only a completed result visibly associated with the newly submitted file is evidence.

decisionPolicy.primary: Use the displayed VIDEO-LEVEL vendor categorical verdict for the current completed upload. Reveal the optional Show video-level results panel if necessary.
decisionPolicy.categoricalMeaning: Match semantically equivalent complete displayed labels and retain their exact text. Unknown/ambiguous labels are no_result. An explicit uncertain verdict remains no_result even when a score is visible.
decisionPolicy.numericFallback: Only if no categorical video-level verdict is provided and the completed UI explicitly identifies a numeric AI-generated video-level score on a known0–1 or0–100% scale: AI when score>=0.5 or>=50%, otherwise not_ai. Unknown scales, generic confidence scores, placeholders, or frame-only scores cannot supply the primary result.
decisionPolicy.scoreQualification: Numeric vendor output is retained as an uncalibrated diagnostic score, not an established probability or certainty of generative origin.
decisionPolicy.primaryScoreDisagreement: If an explicit video-level verdict and numeric score disagree under the fallback threshold, preserve both and flag the disagreement; the explicit video-level verdict remains primary.
decisionPolicy.temporalSecondary: Record all exposed temporal graph/frame results separately. Any exposed per-time AI-generated score>=0.5 or>=50% is a secondary positive-coverage finding only; it never replaces or rescues a primary video-level error or no_result. Record the relationship to the known mixed interval[3,5) without claiming every-frame coverage or validated localization.
decisionPolicy.casePass: A completed interpretable primary ai/not_ai decision exactly matches expectedPrimaryDecision.
decisionPolicy.caseFail: A completed interpretable primary ai/not_ai decision conflicts with expectedPrimaryDecision.
decisionPolicy.caseNoResult: Uncertain or uninterpretable primary result, processing error, timeout, or no completed result associated with the submitted file. No_result is not a correct classification.
decisionPolicy.diagnosticPass: All five fixed cases produce interpretable primary results and all five match. A pass supports only considering a separately frozen independent evaluation, not reliability claims or integration.
decisionPolicy.diagnosticFail: At least one interpretable primary result conflicts with its expected decision. Complete the remaining fixed cases if access permits.
decisionPolicy.diagnosticIncomplete: No primary mismatch was observed, but one or more cases are no_result or not_attempted. Incomplete is not a pass.
decisionPolicy.reporting: Report exact file-level primary and secondary outcomes, attempts, no-results, and stop reasons. Do not report population sensitivity/specificity, calibration, or independent sample counts from this diagnostic.
